# Brandon PT Davis

> Scenic design portfolio, process writing, and studio resources by Brandon PT Davis.

## Core pages

- Home: https://www.brandonptdavis.com/
- Scenic design portfolio: https://www.brandonptdavis.com/projects
- Experiential design portfolio: https://www.brandonptdavis.com/projects/experiential
- Articles: https://www.brandonptdavis.com/articles
- Studio resources: https://www.brandonptdavis.com/studio
- About: https://www.brandonptdavis.com/about
- Contact: https://www.brandonptdavis.com/contact

## Main topics

- Scenic design for theatre, musicals, Shakespeare, regional theatre, and academic productions.
- Scenic rendering, visual storytelling, drafting, model-making, and production design process.
- Vectorworks, Twinmotion, Renderworks, scenic design education, and studio workflow resources.
- Portfolio case studies with production context, design intent, credits, venues, and images.
